model_meta.system_name: Centrifugal Pump with Inclined Balancing-Hole Impeller
model_meta.description: Inferred concept model of a centrifugal pump and its impeller, emphasizing through-shroud balancing holes whose front-face openings are forward in rotation and radially nearer the pump axis than the rear-face openings.

subsystems.description: Pump casing volute surrounding the rotating impeller.
Rear wall of the pump adjacent to the rear side of the impeller.
Pump shaft to which the impeller is attached; the impeller rotates inside the volute.

Rotating impeller assembly including a shroud and front-surface working vanes. Balancing holes extend through the shroud; each front-face opening is ahead of its corresponding rear-face opening in the rotational direction and closer to the pump axis. The holes provide a path for liquid flow through the shroud toward the rear-vane area.
